120.aj: 松本バスターミナル 〒390-0815 日本, １丁目-２-３０ 深志 松本市 長野県 390-0815

rv.t: Bus station staff are extremely helpful to tourists. There is a supermarket underneath, which has chairs so you can eat what you just purchased, or for snacks to take on a bus trip. Across to the left from the train station.
Quiet station; so much more pleasant that Narita or Shinjuku stations
Actually, I came only for the day ticket of the city bus. The lady staff in the bus station did give me a clear instruction about how to use the ticket machine.

121.a: Japan, 〒390-0821 Nagano, Matsumoto, Tsukama, 1 Chome−2−5 手打ちそばとそうすかつ信州家
121.aj: 〒390-0821 長野県松本市筑摩１丁目２−５ 手打ちそばとそうすかつ信州家
catj: 仕出し・ケータリング
121.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious soba noodles and crispy, tender mille-feuille katsu, with many highlighting the generous portions. They also appreciate the calm, traditional Japanese atmosphere and the convenient parking options.
121.edj: このレストランを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、美味しいそばとサクサクでやわらかいミルフィーユカツが高く評価されており、多くの人がボリュームの多さを挙げています。また、落ち着いた伝統的な和の雰囲気や、便利な駐車場の選択肢も好評のようです。

rv.a: นิธิ อจละนันท์
rv.t: A small and cozy soba restaurant about a 15-minute walk from Matsumoto Station. The restaurant is located along a canal and has only around three tables inside, seating roughly 10 people, so it feels quite local and intimate. The crispy pork was excellent. It was fried beautifully—very crispy on the outside, but still juicy and tender inside. It went really well with the soba noodles. I heard that this area’s soba…

family run restaurant that deserves a detour to visit cuz the experience and food r so authentic. the honest katsu, tasty egg roll, basashi, tendon w soba are all perfect. there r 3 lots outside the house and we r so lucky to get 1 free when we arrived.
peaceful and local spot. good dinner

121.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

122.a: Matsumoto City Alps Park, 2455-11 Arigasaki, Matsumoto, Nagano 390-0861, Japan
122.aj: 〒390-0861 長野県松本市蟻ケ崎２４５５−１１ 松本市アルプス公園
122.ed: Hilltop with playgrounds & walking trails, plus an observation deck with views of the Japanese Alps.
122.edj: 丘の上にある公園。遊び場やウォーキング トレイルがある。展望デッキからは日本アルプスを望める。

rv.t: Nice place to chill, it is not the easiest park to get to as public transport via bus is not very frequent. But you can take a taxi and then return via bus provided you get the right timing. Large space and mostly locals. During sakura season, it is absolutely a must. Lots of local will bring food here to picnic. Plenty of places to enjoy yourself and relax.

My son was restless so we ubered out here, so awesome- beautiful views of the town and mountain backdrop, and incredible and large adventure park and playground, with climbing course, rock and slide and the luge was running during the week (June). Haven’t even got to the petting zoo!

I was amazed by the view of the city and the view of the mountain, we've had so much fun there riding on the dream coaster. It was unforgettable place, in planning to go back there again with different season more likely winter.

123.a: Shioinoyu, 3 Chome-6-3 Ote, Matsumoto, Nagano 390-0874, Japan
123.aj: 〒390-0874 長野県松本市大手３丁目６−３ 塩井乃湯
123.ed: People say this public bath offers a unique, retro atmosphere with Taisho-era architecture and wooden lockers, providing a nostalgic experience. They also highlight the hot, authentic spring water that thoroughly warms the body, and appreciate the friendly and helpful staff.
123.edj: この公衆浴場を利用した人は、大正時代の建築様式や木製のロッカーが醸し出す、ユニークでレトロな雰囲気を高く評価しています。また、熱くて本格的な温泉水が体の芯まで温まるという声や、親切で気の利くスタッフへの感謝のクチコミが多くあります。

rv.t: Easy to walk past and miss it completely (if you're not actively looking for a bathhouse). A peak through the glass doors (it was closed at the time) and it looked nice inside. If you're into free public baths, I'm sure this would be recommendable.

This is such a nice place to go near Matsumoto castle. It is a perfect way to end the day. I liked how nice the lady was and how inviting she made me feel. The price of 400 yen was a good deal. It was nice to relax.
Very local and small sentō. Tattoo ok. Sweet old lady running the place. Paid 500¥ (cash only) and she gave me soap and onsen towel.

123.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 15:00

124.a: Shiraito no Yu Hot Spring, 85-1 Satoyamabe, Matsumoto, Nagano 390-0221, Japan
124.aj: 〒390-0221 長野県松本市里山辺８５−１ 白糸の湯
124.ed: People say this onsen offers a relaxing experience with its clear, slightly warm, and soft spring water, featuring both indoor and outdoor baths. Visitors also highlight the affordable 400 yen entry fee, ample free parking, and convenient early morning hours. Other reviews mention the patrons can be impolite.
124.edj: クチコミでは、この温泉は透明で少しぬるめの柔らかいお湯が特徴で、内湯と露天風呂があり、リラックスできると評判です。また、入浴料が400円と手頃で、無料駐車場が広く、早朝から営業している点も利用した人に喜ばれています。 一方で、利用した人の中には、常連客の態度があまり良くないという意見もあります。

rv.t: Lovely onsen, staff are friendly. My partner has an arm tattoo, they said it’s no a problem when we asked if she can come it
A local onsen with a nice outdoor rotenburo!

夜10時まで営業しているのが嬉しい温泉。 泉質は特筆するようなことはなく、ぬるめで長湯がしやすい。 入浴料は2026年2月現在で400円。 PayPayでも支払い可能なのが良い。 ロッカーも100円玉不要のものがある。 ここは美ヶ原温泉だが、もっと奥にある檜の湯に時間的に行くのが難しい（閉店が早い）時にこちらを使う感じ。 露天は東家風で天が覆われているためそれほどの解放感はない。 源泉掛け流しでもないと思われ、本気で温泉を楽しみたいのであれば別の湯も検討しても良いかも知れない。 観光というより、地元の人に愛されている温泉。 → 訂正 看板によると源泉掛け流しとのことでした

125.a: Shiroyama Park Observation Deck, 1133-1 Arigasaki, Matsumoto, Nagano 390-0861, Japan
125.aj: 〒390-0861 長野県松本市蟻ケ崎１１３３−１ 城山公園 展望台

rv.t: Visited on 18/04/2026 in evening just before sunset during Sakura blizzard. Free park nearby our hotel. No words can describe it's tranquility

Decided to run up from accommodation near the main station >> Matsumoto Castle > this observation deck in Joyama Park. Made it here just before sunset. It was so tranquil, and provided a beautiful panoramic view overlooking the city, with mountain ranges in the distance. It was quite an uphill journey (fairly steep in some areas) this way though and cuts through a residential area. I reckon driving up would be a lot…
Nice view over the Minami Alps and Matsumoto twilights Uphill walk up to the park whichever direction you come from. Very quiet on weekdays during winter

126.a: Sioribi, 3 Chome-7-8 Fukashi, Matsumoto, Nagano 390-0815, Japan
126.aj: 〒390-0815 長野県松本市深志３丁目７−８ 栞日
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
126.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious coffee and a variety of baked goods, including tasty scones and simple yet delicious toast. They also highlight the calm, quiet, and relaxing atmosphere, especially on the second floor with its extensive book collection. Guests mention the friendly and welcoming staff, and appreciate the early opening hours.
126.edj: このカフェを利用した人からは、美味しいコーヒーと、美味しいスコーンやシンプルながらも美味しいトーストなど、様々な焼き菓子が提供されていると評判です。また、特に2階の豊富な蔵書がある空間は、穏やかで静かにリラックスできる雰囲気だと高く評価されています。スタッフは親しみやすく、温かい対応をしてくれるという声や、開店時間が早いことを喜ぶクチコミも多くあります。

rv.t: A friend had visited the area and recommended this place. I’m glad I stopped by. The place has two floors, and the second floor was the best. It’s got books and high ceilings and was just comfortable. I ordered a coffee which was poured well. I also got the lemon scone and was very pleased as it was delicious. The staff was very friendly and the service great.

Great coffee place ! They have a good choice of coffee (hot and cold), tea and some pastry. The coffee was really good and the scone was delicious, perfectly cooked, moiste and really tasty. The staff is really friendly, there's a second floor with some book, the atmosphere is perfect!

Sioribi is an absolutely charming cafe and bookstore. It’s beautifully curated. I had an oat milk latte, iced that was really delicious. My son and husband enjoyed a chocolate chip scone and the layers were so perfect. It was served with a dollop of homemade whipped cream. You can sit upstairs or downstairs. Most of the books are upstairs.

127.a: Japan, 〒390-0811 Nagano, Matsumoto, Central, 3 Chome−5−7 ぬのや旅館 1階 TEA TOTIN
127.aj: 〒390-0811 長野県松本市中央３丁目５−７ ぬのや旅館 1階 TEA TOTIN
127.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious and healthy breakfast options, including flavorful onigiri and miso banana bread, with many appreciating the locally sourced ingredients. They also highlight the warm, cozy atmosphere and the reasonable prices for the quality and variety of food. Guests mention the staff are attentive, friendly, and helpful, even for non-Japanese speakers.
127.edj: このカフェを利用した人は、風味豊かなおにぎりや味噌バナナブレッドなど、美味しくて健康的な朝食メニューを高く評価しており、地元の食材が使われている点も好評です。温かく居心地の良い雰囲気や、料理の質と種類の豊富さに対して手頃な価格であることも特徴です。また、スタッフは親切で感じが良く、日本語を話さない人にも丁寧に対応してくれるというクチコミが多くあります。

rv.t: We enjoyed Miso Banana Bread and green tea for breakfast. It was delicious and the service was lovely. Would love to visit at lunch as well. Interesting menu!

It's a small little café with a very sweet and nice chef, who makes the most delicious food! Even as vegetarians we had some options and oat milk coffee was also available with a slight price increase. The price generally is totally fine for how lovely the food is prepared and how tasty it was. Can only recommend you giving it a try, but try coming early! We were there at 9:00 am and the onigiri plate was already…

Fantastic small cafe. We were staying the ryokan and the cafe offered breakfast to the guests. It was locally sourced and felt very authentic. As non-japanese speakers we felt very welcome and it had a warm atmosphere. Absolutely recommend for an authentic breakfast.

128.a: ユキタコーヒー Yukita, 2 Chome-5-11 Central, Matsumoto, Nagano 390-0811, Japan
128.aj: ユキタコーヒー Yukita, ２丁目-５-１１ 中央 松本市 長野県 390-0811
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店

rv.t: Nice little cafe with a welcoming owner and good drinks
Lovely woman! She was very nice and we felt welcomed The place is small and cozy. We recommend the chilliconcarne toast
Rare light to middle roast hand drip coffee in Japan, a must try

129.a: Fukashi-jinja Shrine, 3 Chome-7-43 Fukashi, Matsumoto, Nagano 390-0815, Japan
129.aj: 〒390-0815 長野県松本市深志３丁目７−４３ 深志神社
129.ed: Temple dedicated to a revered scholar, with carved lion & bull statues & a lively summer festival.
129.edj: 崇拝されている学者を祀る神社。狛犬と牛の彫像や、活気ある夏祭りで知られる。

rv.t: I wanted to shake the rope, after put the money in, but I lost timing🤪 I loved being present here🤗
Nice shrine calm with not a lot of people, possible to have a goshuin.
Very cool Shinto Shrine in Matsumoto. Looks like a few shrines here. Well kept and easy to find.

129.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 9:00

130.a: Totouan Biwa no Yu, 3 Chome-26-1 Asamaonsen, Matsumoto, Nagano 390-0303, Japan
130.aj: 〒390-0303 長野県松本市浅間温泉３丁目２６−１ 湯々庵 枇杷の湯
130.ed: Visitors say this onsen offers a serene atmosphere with well-maintained indoor and outdoor baths, including a cypress outdoor bath, and a sauna. They also highlight the reasonable 900 yen entry fee for day use and the availability of private onsen options. Guests mention the staff are kind, helpful, and patient, making for a relaxing and welcoming experience.
130.edj: クチコミによると、この温泉は手入れの行き届いた内湯と露天風呂、檜の露天風呂、サウナがあり、穏やかな雰囲気でリラックスできると評判です。日帰り入浴は900円と手頃な料金で、貸し切り風呂も利用できるという声もあります。スタッフは親切で、丁寧な対応をしてくれるため、心安らぐひとときを過ごせるという感想が多くあります。

rv.t: Our host kindly recommended and arranged a private onsen for our family at short notice during our stay in early February. Although the location is slightly out of the way, it was easy to reach by bus, and a taxi would be an even more convenient option if you prefer direct access. We spent a relaxing hour in the hot waters within our own private space, surrounded by a serene atmosphere. The staff were warm and…

We used the private open air onsen for only 2000¥ per person per hour. We had to do reservations because it was on New Year’s Holidays but the lady let us get in before half an hour as we reached early than the designated time. The water was so good. We could enjoy our time. 😇 They had shampoo, conditioner, body soap, hair fryer, earbuds and a small towel but we need to bring our own bath towel.

This was such a beautiful experience! We were able to use the private onsen without a reservation. The cost is a bit more per person (2000 yen) but worth every penny. The place was very clean and so serene! The water was divine! The onsen is located in the outskirts of the city but well worth the drive. There is a small coffee shop inside with drinks and ice cream, bonus after a warm soak. One of the best…

130.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 9:00

131.a: Coffee Marumo, 3 Chome-3-10 Central, Matsumoto, Nagano 390-0811, Japan
131.aj: 〒390-0811 長野県松本市中央３丁目３−１０ 珈琲 まるも
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
131.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious coffee, especially the original blend, and popular menu items like the honey toast and matcha cheesecake. They also highlight the cozy, traditional atmosphere with classic music and antique furnishings. Guests mention the staff are attentive and provide excellent service.
131.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、おいしいコーヒー、特にオリジナルブレンドが高く評価されています。ハニートーストや抹茶チーズケーキなどの人気メニューも好評です。また、クラシック音楽とアンティーク調の家具が配された、居心地の良い伝統的な雰囲気が特徴です。スタッフは気配りができており、素晴らしいサービスを提供しているという声が多くあります。

rv.a: chu a H o c K s a n (Jase)
rv.t: Not only l I love this cafe, I also like the toast and salad. I had the blended coffee and my wife tried the charcoaled coffee. Soaking in such classical ambience with space filled of caffeine aroma on a cold day outside is an “addiction.” 😄

I ordered honey and buttered toast with house blend coffee set. Perfectly toasted bread, very soft yet crispy especially on the side part. Coffee also great. Good atmosphere, very cozy, calm and quiet.
A lovely vintage cafe with strong coffee, which is excellent in my view. The honey walnut toast was likewise superb - generously drenched in honey and piled with walnuts. Hearty start to the day!

133.ed: Pedestrian street with a lively vibe featuring shops, cafes, food vendors & frog-themed souvenirs.
133.edj: ショップ、カフェ、食べ歩きできる店、カエルをモチーフにした土産物が並ぶ、賑やかな雰囲気の歩行者専用の通り。

rv.t: Ran into some super-fans of the iconic mascot frog at its fascinating Sunday flea market. It was an extraordinary experience, and I was deeply impressed by their immense passion for the frogs.

Came here around first week of February 2026 at night time but there were no open stores, not sure why, thought I’ll be seeing food stalls or yatais. It’s the gateway towards Matsumoto castle and the views during my walk from Matsumoto station to here was pretty neat.

A charming little street on the way to Matsumoto Castle. Nawate Street is short but packed with character. I loved the scenic riverside walk with beautiful vintage lamp posts. It’s right next to Yohashira Shrine, where you can sit and enjoy a peaceful moment. Great local snacks and lovely small shops. Highly recommend for a relaxing break!"

134.a: Matsumoto Castle, 4-1 Marunouchi, Matsumoto, Nagano 390-0873, Japan
134.aj: 〒390-0873 長野県松本市丸の内４−１ 松本城
134.ed: Known for its black walls, this grand, 16th-century castle features exhibits of historical weapons.
134.edj: 黒い壁で知られる壮大な 16 世紀の城。歴史的な武器の展示がある。

rv.t: Matsumoto Castle is one of Japan's most beautiful and well-preserved historic castles. Its striking black exterior, surrounded by a moat and the Japanese Alps in the background, creates a breathtaking view that's perfect for photography. The castle grounds are peaceful and beautifully maintained, making it enjoyable to explore at a relaxed pace. Inside, you can learn about the castle's rich history while climbing…

Beautiful Castle, But Not for Everyone Matsumoto Castle is undoubtedly one of the most beautiful castles in Japan. The striking black exterior, the surrounding grounds, and the reflections in the moat make it a wonderful place to visit and photograph. The castle has a genuine historic feel and is far more authentic than many other castles that have been heavily reconstructed. However, visitors should be aware that…

Unlike many other rebuilt castles in Japan, this is an original castle, one of Japan's twelve original keeps. You can really feel the age and authenticity as you climb through the interior. The exterior and the surrounding moat are impeccably kept and look very classy. The wooden stairs inside are incredibly steep and narrow (almost like ladders in some spots). You’ll need to take your shoes off at the entrance, so…

135.a: DOLCE TACUBO, チェラーザ代官山 1階 2 Chome-15-9 Ebisunishi, Shibuya, Tokyo 150-0021, Japan
135.aj: 〒150-0021 東京都渋谷区恵比寿西２丁目１５−９ チェラーザ代官山 1階 DOLCE TACUBO 代官山
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
135.ed: People say this dessert shop offers exceptional quality pastries, including delicious financiers with a crispy exterior and moist interior, and rich cream puffs. They also highlight the smooth, milky soft serve and gelato with unique seasonal flavors. Visitors appreciate the elegant atmosphere and the convenient outdoor benches for enjoying treats immediately.
135.edj: このデザートショップを訪れた人は、質の高いお菓子を提供していると評価しています。外はカリカリ、中はしっとりとしたフィナンシェや、濃厚なクリームが詰まったシュークリームが特に美味しいという声が多くあります。また、なめらかな口当たりのミルキーなソフトクリームや、季節ごとに変わる珍しいフレーバーのジェラートも評判のようです。おしゃれな雰囲気も魅力で、店外に設置されたベンチで、購入したお菓子をすぐに楽しめる点も喜ばれています。

rv.t: A seasonal cherry blossom series soft serve. It’s not overly sweet, with a subtle salty note from the sakura that adds a nice balance. You can really taste the quality, and the presentation is beautiful and uplifting. At 1,000 yen, it’s not cheap, so it’s not something you’d have every day, but it feels like a special treat.
Chic and tasty dessert shop at Daikanyama; the financiers are particular tasty. But seating space is somewhat limited
too good to be true and impossible to enjoy just once. In fact, it's so good that it also made it onto our ultimate list of Best Desserts in Tokyo. A must visit for Tokyo dessert lovers

135.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

136.a: Okina, 1 Chome-7-6 Yutakacho, Shinagawa City, Tokyo 142-0042, Japan
136.aj: 〒142-0042 東京都品川区豊町１丁目７−６ 蕎麦切り 翁
136.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious soba, with options for thin or thick noodles, and highlight the flavorful side dishes like katsu-ni and an liver nimono. They also mention the cozy and calm atmosphere, making it suitable for dates. Guests appreciate the quality of the food, noting that payment is cash only.
136.edj: このお店を利用した人は、美味しいそばを高く評価しています。細麺と太麺から選べるそばは、どちらも美味しいと評判です。また、カツ煮やあん肝の煮物など、一品料理も美味しいという声が多くあります。店内は落ち着いた雰囲気で、デートにも適しているという意見もあります。料理の質が高いと評価されていますが、支払いは現金のみという情報もあります。

rv.t: Are you a fan of Soba Noodles? Then please try this tiny place. Dashimaki tamago was divine, selection of Sake was fab and most importantly, they serve a great Inaka soba. Get ready for your google translate and explore the traditional ones! Please remember that this is a very popular shop and people tend to queue outside travel light is a must. Don’t bring your suitcases there, ok?

Ordered "Soba Gozen". Gozen arrived first without Soba. Then, waited 15 min. for Soba arriving, while the chef was serving Soba for the other customers. Soba Gozen is supposed to eat with Soba, in my understanding. However, as my Soba was forgotten for a while, I was forced to eat Gozen and Soba separately. Not a pleasant experience. Never come back.
Cute place with very good food and very affordable

136.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

137.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious, freshly made soba noodles and a variety of other offerings, including fresh sashimi, tempura, and katsudon. They also highlight the reasonable prices for the quality and the welcoming atmosphere that attracts a diverse clientele. Some reviews mention the service can be slow.
137.edj: このお店を利用した人は、打ちたての美味しいそばや、新鮮な刺身、天ぷら、カツ丼など、豊富なメニューを評価しています。また、品質に対して価格が手頃であることや、多様な客層を惹きつける居心地の良い雰囲気も特徴です。 クチコミでは、料理の提供が遅いという声もあります。

rv.t: The firm soba noodles and large shrimp tempura were delicious. Many people were enjoying soba with sake.
The staff was very nice and the restaurant very clean. There weren't a lot of seats and the place filled up fairly quickly. The food was good but a little bit expensive for what they offer.
Different from most soba restaurants, they have a lot of dishes other than soba such as sashimi, curry, fried food etc. Great quality and value, would highly recommend to go during lunch.

137.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

A little too old.
東京建築祭で訪問しました、屋上からは皇居をはじめとして、都心を一望できました、普段は入ることができないので、とても感動しました

Limited choice of Coffee though the house blend was smooth. Paired the coffee with the Fuji apple juice. Overall a nice and cosy place to spend a morning.

a cozy little bakery with a fantastic variety of yummy treats! Everything looked so delicious, and what I tried was super tasty. Plus, some of the staff can speak English, which was a big help. Really lovely atmosphere – a great spot to grab a bite!

The soy sauce has this wonderful sweet flavor, and when you mix it with the egg and rice, the texture is just heavenly. The chefs and staff are really warm and welcoming, too, and you can easily communicate in English. Just a heads-up, though: everyone has to…

First off yes I went here because of YouTube. It was a rainy day and I arrived before the lunch rush which was a great way to go about it. They had prepped a chair for me while I was standing outside looking like a tourist and had already set out the English menu for me. I of course ordered the Premium Pork with "over hard" (scrambled) eggs and an orange juice. (Which came in a bottle and is more of a non-carbonated…

I was able to get a table right away without having to wait on a weekday. The staff communicated with me in English, even though I tried to speak Japanese. But it was really nice to see such great service and friendliness toward foreigners anyway. The portion size was quite big though I ordered a regular size (150g of pork). And I understand that you can ask for takeaway if you can’t finish it. The pork was very…

rv.t: When I heard about this place. As a milk lover, I definitely wanted to go. The place was so cute! Loved the cow decors especially the huge ones inside. There were 2 floors. We ordered The Strawberry Cake with Fresh Cream, The Butter Pancake with…

Super fun place to visit. Everything here tastes wonderful. We each got the milk flight, chocolate milk, and Cafe latte. It was nice to try the different milks and taste the subtle differences. All weee great. The chocolate milk was very good. Not sure if it’s because of the milk they use or the chocolate but it’s better than any chocolate milk in the U.S. The latte was good. I think the coffee itself is just coffee…

This was a really interesting cafe. They were friendly and explained everything to us. Trying the milk and cheese platter was fun and very tasty. I loved the giant cow. Definitely a unique experience.

The vibes are great, they have djs on the weekends. The staff are friendly too. You should definitely stop by if you like matcha and music!
The matcha latte is amazing. Rich in flavor and good balance with oat milk. A very cozy shop to hangout with your girl friends.

Lovely cafe with great music and vibes. We requested some Sade and they were happy to play it, bless them. The speakers and overall sound system is amazing! All the ladies were super kind and the matcha is the best we’ve had in Tokyo and our trip is coming to an end! Highly recommend 🫶🏾

They don’t allow you to have 2 people with just 1 person’s order for sharing! Also they are not cheap!

Great presentation, lovely atmosphere, but very pricy for the quality of food and service you’re getting. Some of the dishes were very tasty, like the Hungary Foie Gras Poêlé, 3rd on their course menu. Others, like roast beef, 6th on their course menu, was very average. The texture was a bit rubbery and very difficult to chew. Not what you’d expect from wagyu, and certainly not worth the ¥12,000 per person price…

The food service was a bit slow, but it fit the zen vibe. We had a simple traditional Japanese breakfast with tea variants (Asacha breakfast), and I really enjoyed the unique experience. I did enjoy my non-alcoholic sake wagashi and matcha tea. This is a must-try!

The spices are layered beautifully, and as you keep eating, different notes continue to emerge. It’s a very well-executed biryani. The restaurant is counter-style, creating a calm environment where you can really focus on the food. The…

You have a choice of regular or full size serving (no extra cost). I opted for…

We didn’t want to bike either but were lucky to have found a 2 hours tour which departs from the Lily Field Park. It was a small tour and it stopped at all the scenic spots.

Ie Island is a truly beautiful destination. Don’t miss out on trying the Ie Island beef steak—especially the Hizajura Beef Steak. It’s an authentic taste of Japan, rich in taste! The meat was tender, juicy, and unforgettable. Highly recommended!

A bit short on amenities, but if you're up for an adventure and trying to get away from it all, you're at the right place. We got stuck there a little longer than expected due to a little hurricane that stopped the ferry service for a few days.

Guests mention the calm, traditional Japanese atmosphere and the attentive staff who explain how to best…
156.edj: このレストランを利用した人は、すき焼き仕立ての親子鍋定食を評価しています。やわらかい鶏肉と、ご飯によく合う甘めの江戸味噌の出汁が特徴です。まずすき焼きとして、次に親子丼として、一度の食事で二つの味を楽しめる点も好評です。落ち着いた和の雰囲気や、料理の食べ方を丁寧に説明してくれるスタッフの対応も良いというクチコミがあります。

rv.t: 神保町 かつら 【すき焼き仕立ての親子鍋定食 ～かしわ肉～ 1400円】 みた目も味も2度美味しい！ 歌舞伎の演目にも登場する "伝統味噌”を使ったすき焼き鍋 他では味わえない「かしわ鍋」を頂きました。 特製味噌の凝縮された旨味とコクが、銘柄鶏かしわ肉と 絶妙にマッチして極上の味わいに✨ 最初は玉子にくぐらせてすき焼きでたべるのがオススメ！ 途中で鍋に玉子を入れてトロトロにし、 ご飯の上に乗せて親子丼😋 ランチなのに、ご予約可能🫶 更にランチご予約限定で個室利用&ドリンク付コースが嬉しい☺️ 女子会や会食にも◎ 神保町駅から徒歩2分

rv.a: とりっぴーの麺スタグラム
rv.t: 🍲 すき焼き・鶏料理・居酒屋 かつら（神保町 / 東京） 休日のお昼、お腹を空かせてふらっと立ち寄ったこのお店。店内はカジュアルでどこか落ち着く雰囲気で、昼時は地元のビジネスパーソンや友人同士で賑わっていました。ランチでオーダーしたのは「すき焼き仕立ての親子鍋定食 ～かしわ肉～（1,400円）」。 鍋がテーブルに届くと、立ち上る湯気とともにふわっと広がる味噌と鶏の旨味の香りが食欲を刺激🍶。黄金色に輝く出汁は、幻の江戸伝統味噌がベースになっていてコク深く、ほんのり甘みも感じられます。 まずは、熱々の鍋で火の通ったかしわ肉を玉子にくぐらせてひと口…！とろけるように柔らかく、味噌の旨味が玉子のまろやかさと絡み合い、心までほっとする味わい🥚。途中で玉子を鍋に投入すると、ぐつぐつとろけてとろとろ食感が加わり、お米にオンして親子丼としても楽しめるのがこの定食の特長です🍚✨…

神保町駅より徒歩2分 赤い暖簾が目をひく歴史感じる、すき焼きの看板。 13時から４名で予約、ランチ会しました。 幻の江戸伝統味噌を使用したすき焼き鍋店！ 注文したのは、 【すき焼き仕立ての親子鍋定食-かしわ肉- 1400円(税込)】 リーズナブル！ 最初は玉子にくぐらせすき焼きで！ 途中で鍋に玉子入れてトロトロにし、ごはんに乗せて親子丼風に！ と味変も楽しめました！ お喋りしながら、玉子が硬くならないようタイミング考えたりして、楽しいランチ会となりました。

157.edj: このレストランを利用したユーザーは、新鮮な刺身やボリュームのある牛タン料理など、種類豊富なランチ定食を高く評価しています。多くの選択肢があり、自分好みにカスタマイズできる点も好評です。また、手頃な価格と十分な量、活気があり広々とした雰囲気も特徴として挙げられています。 一方で、クチコミでは、料理の提供が遅いという意見もあります。

rv.t: My favorite Izakaya. The price, the atmosphere and the food is all amazing. One of the few restaurants in Tokyo where you don’t have to worry about being more than 4 people. The Fried Mochi and the Chikenkatsu are must get meals. I can’t wait to see you again Shohei!
Easily my favorite restaurant while I traveled Japan. Warm and welcoming, the staff were fantastic and friendly. The food was incredible. I would go back everytime I'm in Japan.

Excellent dinner here! i went there with my boyfriend and a Japanese friend. The waitress knew we are foreigners, so she took care of us very well. Although there are no english menu, she tried to explain . The waitress named "Kirara", we like her service and big smile . Appreciated!

158.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious soba, especially the curry nanban soba, and the hearty katsudon. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the wide variety of menu options, including mini-sets. Guests mention the welcoming, old-fashioned atmosphere and the kind, attentive staff.
158.edj: このそば店を利用した人は、美味しいそば、特にカレー南蛮そばや、ボリュームのあるカツ丼を評価しています。手頃な価格や、ミニセットを含む豊富なメニューも特徴として挙げられています。昔ながらの落ち着いた雰囲気や、親切で気の利くスタッフも好評のようです。

rv.t: Some kind mechanics at a local bike shop recommended this to me, and it was the best meal I have had in Tokyo. The cold soba was perfect and the tempura delicious on a hot summer day. And the staff were kind and welcoming to a solo traveler — so glad I came here.
Shrimp tempura soba is highly suggested! Veryyy flavorful. Accommodating to tourists with a translated menu.
Great little spot for noodles. Food is top of the line and staff are kind. They have an English “point and pick” menu.

159.ed: Diners like this ramen shop's delicious and reasonably priced shio ramen, noting its clear, flavorful broth and tender chashu. They also highlight the tasty fried rice and gyoza, along with the warm and attentive staff.
159.edj: このラーメン店を訪れた人は、透き通ったスープとやわらかいチャーシューが特徴の看板メニューである塩ラーメンを高く評価しています。また、チャーハンやギョーザもおいしいという声が多くあります。手頃な価格と温かく丁寧なサービスも評判のようです。中には、お子様ラーメンがあるため、家族連れでも利用しやすいというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: The simple.
ランチに塩ラーメン（650円）をいただきました。スープは澄んであっさりしつつ旨味が濃く、細麺によく絡んで、最後の一滴まで残さず美味しくいただけました。店員さんの対応も温かく気持ち良く食事ができるお店です。また行きたいと思います。

平日の昼前に来店。入り口で名前書いて、裏の和室に案内されました。名物と言う塩ラーメンを頂きました。まず、650円だったかな、今時すごい値段ですね。塩スープはとてもあっさりしていて飲みやすいです、出汁も効いてて飲み続けられそう。細麺のわりに腰があり麺も中々に美味しいです。ただ、スープとの絡みが悪いのか、麺だけだと弱いですね。塩ラーメンはスープを強くしすぎるとくどいので、麺はあっさりで良いのかもしれませんが、もう、一味足りない感じ、チャーシューも美味しいですが、やはりチャーシュー食べた後、全体が薄く感じてしまう。もう少しだけ濃くても良いのかも。次回は口コミが多いチャーハンも頂いてみたいですね。

rv.t: CICADA is a beautiful restaurant with a distinctive atmosphere, but the overall dining experience did not fully meet my expectations. Atmosphere: Excellent. The restaurant has a romantic and relaxing ambiance, especially in the evening. Interior design: Very impressive and carefully designed. The setting is probably the restaurant’s strongest point. Parking: Not very convenient, so arriving by public transportation…

CICADA looked promising and the dishes were attractively presented, but overall the experience fell a little short for us. The food was decent enough, however the flavours lacked the depth and authenticity we were expecting. The chicken tagine, in particular, was comforting but didn’t really capture the rich, aromatic character that makes this dish so memorable. The meatballs and crab cakes were pleasant, yet none…

It’s a cute date place, service is excellent, vibe is great but I think it is a bit overpriced as the cost and flavor don’t match. I liked the risotto and would gladly pay 2000- 3000 for it but not 4K again. We got the 3 dips but you can definitely skip babaganoush. The best thing was the pistachio brûlée. Would definitely return just for the pistachio brûlée

161.aj: 〒135-0004 東京都江東区森下２丁目１９−９ 桜鍋みの家本店
161.ed: Traditional setting with long floor tables, specializing in hot pots made with horse meat.
161.edj: 座卓の長テーブルを置いた、昔ながらの雰囲気の店。桜肉（馬肉）を使った鍋料理を提供。

rv.t: My foodie friend recommended this amazing restaurant. I wanted to eat horse sashimi and all three choices they offered were so fresh and delicious. We had three sashimi, one Sakura nabe, rice and raw eggs and it was just perfect! The atmosphere was very nice - traditional house with a beautiful garden view at the end of the hallway. The service was quick and kind. They also sell bayu so I picked one up to take home…

For horse meat in Tokyo, this place is a sure bet. Established in 1897, Minoya is a renowned restaurant. Their signature sakura nabe is simmered in a blend of hatcho miso and dashi broth. The meat is cooked quickly to prevent toughening, then dipped in beaten egg. Fresh basashi (horse sashimi) and aburasashi (marbled horse fat) are also must-tries. Just a 1-minute walk from Morishita Station. Reservations accepted…

Horse Meat Restaurant This restaurant is specilised in horse dishes such as sashimi and miso-based hot pot. It may not be preferable to foreigners to eat horse meat in raw, but hot pot is worth to try. The meat is tender and perfect combination with miso paste. The restaurant opened in 1954, and you can feel old style of architecture while you eat it.

All sets are very nicely presented and the flavor is great. The quantity of food is quite big - we could barely finish our meal. So don't go there unless you're very hungry. The staff is very nice.

Been here twice. First time I got tempura soba and the next I got the katsudon set. The soba is great. Katsudon was really good. I don’t know why but I don’t love the shrimp tempura. The tempura itself is great though. I’ll come back again. It’s a very simple and convenient restaurant.

rv.t: My wife and I just had a lovely meal at this restaurant. The chicken nabi was excellently seasoned and the Mizutaki was a truly unique and delicious experience! Our very kind server handled the Mizutaki cooking, and it was for the best because there are several steps and she did a wonderful job. We will most certainly come back to this restaurant when we are next in Tokyo!
Authentic

予約して、口開けからお邪魔しました。 博多で食べた水炊きを東京で食べられるお店を探して巡り会えました。 いただいたのは、酢もつ、ごま鯖、チキン南蛮、水炊きです。 どの料理もとても美味しかった。酢もつは適度な酸味に臭みのないモツの旨み。お酒が進みます。ごま鯖は沢山の薬味とわさびを合わせて。さらに酒がうまい。チキン南蛮はコロモをまとった柔らかい鶏肉が酸味と甘味のタレに浸かってタルタルソースをかけて。とても美味しい。自宅で再現確定。水炊きは期待通り。食べ方指南も博多で食べたそれ。スープを味わって、具を食べて、最後は雑炊で締めました。 カミさんもとても喜んでいました。良い思い出になりました。

rv.t: I was amazed by how delicious Sri Lankan cuisine can be! The seasonal fresh watermelon juice was absolutely incredible too. Definitely must try!!

初めてのスリランカカレーでした。今夜のカレーはココナッツ風味のとてもマイルドなカレーでした。スリランカカレーの特徴なのかは不明です。いつもはネパール、バングラデシュ、インドのカレーが多いのですが、南アジアと言っても、国によっていろんなカレーがあるのが面白い！ 付け合わせでパイナップルのアチャールをつけたのですが、初めての味でとても新鮮でした。それとディナータイムは１人ワンドリンクがマストとのことでスパイスチャイにしたのですが、これまた初めての味！とてもよい経験ができたお店でした！

スリランカカレーが食べたくて、出先の近くにあることがわかりお邪魔しました。 平日のディナーオープンと同時に入りました。席の予約がされていたテーブルもあるので、もしかしたらラッキーだったのかもしれません。 イワシが載っているのが良くてイワシを追加しました。イワシを追加すると2000円近くになります。イワシなしだと1500円前後でした。 まずは一口ずつ食べてその後は好きに混ぜて。 カレーは選べます。 美味しかったです。私が来店中にハンディキャップある方が来店されていたのですが、お店の方の対応も良くてその方達も楽しそうに召し上がっててほっこりしました。

Sad experience. We had a salad and 2 glasses of sake and we spent 4900 yen. They charged 2000 yen for an entree that we did not order. They didn’t tell us there was an extra charge.

I think they have discrimination against foreigners. They asked us how many we are and when they saw we’re foreigners, they said there’s no table available. But they let in the Japanese who asked after us.

rv.t: I've spent 14 days in Tokyo so far, and eaten at a variety of great restaurants every day, and the food here is by far the best I've tasted! I walked past this bustling little shop a couple of times on the way home from the train, and finally had the opportunity to eat here. The friendly waiter suggested sashimi, potato salad and fried chicken (since I couldn't read the menu) and I wasn't sure what to expect. The…

It was delicious! Everything I tried was super good! I will go again. Be aware that is all in Japanese, so I recommend going with someone who can speak and read Japanese as the menu change depending on what's available.
A Reasonable Standing Izakaya place. I used to come to this place before spreading Covid-19. I love the place. I especially love their fish, super fresh!

Delightful dinner! We were pleasantly surprised with our meal and the service. Small place with many local diners. We had the panna cotta, which was like the inside of burrata cheese, the zucchini with mint salsa verde, aqua pazza with red sea bream, grilled maitake mushrooms and small appetizer platter for two which was filled with many delicious items! Their otoshi appetizer with 5 kinds of fish and onion dressing…

We came across ROBATA after several other restaurants were fully booked. We saw it listed as Italian food and decided to give it a try. From the outside and being on the second floor, the restaurant may go unnoticed from the street. However, once you step inside, you’re transformed into a unique and memorable environment - vibrant yet intimate, full of character, and with a classy primitive vibe. With seating…

168.edj: カウンター席のある気取らない雰囲気の店。2 種類の麺から選べる濃厚な出汁のラーメンと卵かけご飯を提供。

rv.t: It was actually my first time trying soba-style tsukemen, and honestly, I wasn't sure what to expect since I’m used to the super thick, heavy ramen broths. This was totally different in the best way. The broth is clear and refined, not oily at all, with a really nice hit of yuzu and dried sardines (niboshi). The coolest part is that they serve two types of noodles in one bowl: one is thin and smooth like traditional…

I highly recommend this amazing tsukemen restaurant. They use two different types of ramen noodles. The different diameters really create a unique dipping ramen experience. If you order the deluxe bowl, you get chashu, pork belly and shrimp wontons. The pork belly was succulent. I added a dash of chili powder and vinegar for my broth. They have an English written menu to order at the kiosk. Note this place is cash…

Phenomenal tsukemen here where they serve two different types of noodles in each order. One is white, thinner, and has a little less chew while the other is a thick, yellow, chewier noodle. Both are amazing. The fish and pork dipping broth is amazing and comes with chashu pork that’s been slightly charred with a torch before being served which adds an extra smoky depth to the meat and the broth. A must try for…

169.a: Hanatako, 3 Chome-7-13 Takaban, Meguro City, Tokyo 152-0004, Japan

169.ed: People say this takoyaki shop offers delicious takoyaki with a crispy exterior and fluffy interior, and appreciate the generous portions of octopus and cabbage. They also highlight the incredibly reasonable prices and the friendly, welcoming atmosphere. Some reviews mention the takoyaki can be overcooked.
169.edj: クチコミによると、このたこ焼き店は外はカリッと香ばしく、中はふわふわのたこ焼きが美味しいと評判です。タコやキャベツがたっぷり入っていて、ボリュームがある点も評価されています。また、驚くほど手頃な価格と、親しみやすく温かい雰囲気が特徴です。 一方で、たこ焼きが焦げすぎていることがあるという意見もあります。

rv.t: 学芸大学のローカル感あふれるたこ焼き屋「花たこ」に訪問。駅からすぐの場所にあり、昔ながらの雰囲気でどこか懐かしさを感じるお店です。たこ焼きは6個で250円とかなりリーズナブルで、このご時世では驚きの価格帯。外はカリッと香ばしく、中はとろっとした生地で食感のバランスが良く、タコも大きめで食べ応えがあります。味付けはソースやマヨ、ポン酢など選べて、特にマヨたこは濃厚で満足度高め。店内は少しディープな空気感がありますが、それも含めて味のあるお店で、地元に長く愛されている理由がわかる一軒でした。飲みの〆や軽くつまみたい時にもぴったりです。

店員さんに聞いたら お通し300円x2 黒ラベルビール700円x2 タコ焼き300円x1 会計2,300円になることが正しいと思いますが、 会計した時、レシートとか詳しく書いているメニューもなしに店主のおばあさんが勝手に 「1人ずつお通し+ビールセットで1,500円、たこ焼き500円」って言われて3,500円を払いました。 急に500円のたこ焼きは何？ 今回は文句なしに払ってますが2度とは絶対行かない。 そして店主のおばあさんが外国人の店員さんが日本語下手だと陰口を叩きます。 いろいろ最低

マヨタコ300円/6個入り やすいので文句は言えないかと思いますが、にしたって最近は急に、お焦げを楽しむレベルを越したジャンクすぎるカチカチ焦げたものも入れられるのように。以前は稀にあるかなくらいでしたが。もう流石にありえないかと。 たまたまかな？と思い懲りずに通っていましたが毎回:これがUberだと倍以上の750円になるのは恐ろしい。 安くていつも熱々で提供してくれるので ずっと通っていましたがもう行かないです。 少し課金して近くのTokyuStoreのお惣菜たこ焼きの方が断然美味しいです。

170.edj: このベトナム料理店を訪れた人は、本格的なバインミーを高く評価しています。パンはサクサクで具材がたっぷり入っており、風味豊かなフォーや他のベトナム料理も人気です。価格が手頃な点や、バインミーのサイズを選べる点も好評です。スタッフは親しみやすく、券売機での効率的な注文システムも利用した人に喜ばれています。

rv.t: This small shop in the heart of Jimbocho turned out to be an excellent stop for a quick, satisfying meal. The bánh mì was probably the best I’ve ever had—light, crisp bread, plenty of herbs, and a perfectly balanced filling. We ordered the set that combines a bánh mì with a bowl of pho, and it was genuinely a good deal. The pho portion was large, aromatic, and full of flavour, far more generous than you would expect…

one of the best vietnamese food restaurants in tokyo in my opinion. they keep the banh my bread very crunchy while the veggies inside still very fresh which many places forgot to do. the staff are very friendly and welcoming. please keep up the good work.
It was the best banhmi I had outside of Vietnam. I ordered pho banhmi combo. Pho was definitely good , had all the right ingredients made me feel like eating in Vietnam .

Food is nice, just the environment is a little outdated. Service is good though.

Delicious dumplings for a great price! Came here for lunch with my partner and it only costed 2400 yen for 4 dishes! The Mapo tofu is a popular dish here. No issues with the staff, despite the restaurant's reputation. Definitely recommend if you are after good chinese food.

The curry is…

We were wandering around the area and could smell this restaurant from further up the street. Unfortunately at the time it was closed but we knew we wanted to come back and I’m so glad we did. 177.ed: Diners like this restaurant's Miyazaki beef hamburg steaks, which are served rare with a hot stone for custom cooking, and the sirloin rice bowls, which can be enjoyed three ways. They also highlight the variety of sauces and seasonings, including salt and wasabi, and the complimentary rice refills. Guests mention the staff are polite and welcoming, and the atmosphere is clean and relaxing.
177.edj: このレストランを利用した人は、宮崎牛のハンバーグやサーロイン重を高く評価しています。ハンバーグはレアな状態で提供され、熱い石で好みの焼き加減に調整できる点が好評です。また、サーロイン重はそのまま、薬味を添えて、最後に出汁をかけてと、3通りの食べ方で楽しめる点が特徴です。塩やわさびなど、様々なソースや調味料が用意されており、ご飯のおかわりが無料であることも喜ばれています。訪れた人からは、スタッフが丁寧で感じが良く、店内は清潔で落ち着いた雰囲気だという声が多く聞かれます。

rv.t: Tried the A5 Miyazaki Wagyu sirloin “gyu-mabushi” style and it was absolutely delicious. The wagyu was incredibly tender with beautiful marbling, rich umami, and a gentle sweetness that spread with every bite. The quality of the Miyazaki beef really stood out. It’s also fun to enjoy the dish in three different ways, which makes the meal feel even more special. A wonderful place to experience premium wagyu.

The staff were so kind and accommodating. The atmosphere was great. The food was incredible. We had the sirloin bowl and hamburgers. Honestly the best beef I’ve ever tasted, melt in your mouth amazingly good. The miso was delicious too. If in Tokyo this is a must visit!! Thank you

My go-to place whenever I’m asked about good restaurants in Kanda. Their hamburg is really tasty, and the staff are polite. I’ve already recommended this place to a few colleagues. Great for dining with friends or for eating by yourself. Note that most customers tend to be office workers though

rv.t: Visited Garden White and had a really nice experience. The place has a clean, minimal, and calm atmosphere that makes it perfect to relax and enjoy your time. The food and drinks were fresh and well prepared. Presentation was simple but nice, and everything tasted good. It’s a good spot if you want something light and refreshing. I also liked the quiet environment. It’s not too crowded, so you can sit comfortably…
Very nice and spacious Italian place in the Ebisu station Atre! Pizza and pasta are outstanding as if you were in Italy!
Gorgeous place and food was amazing!

Personal favorites: Burnt Cheesecake and Hojicha! I loved the smoked and roasted taste of the Hojicha flavor. My husband prefers the Matcha, but I find it too “green” for my taste.

Cheesecake were so delicious, but not enough! Definitely would like to eat more 😂. Pistachio, purple potato and walnut chocolate, that's what I've had... And I need more. Also lady that was there was really lovely. Easy to talk, always smiling and happy to help. Next time in Hiroshima I need to visit again.

For us the best cheese cake (plain) in town. Super creamy, well balanced in taste and the person serving us today was just sweet.
